pages.useful_because: The homepage is the only page that puts all of All Connected Electric LLC's work in one place: the three sectors it covers (residential, commercial, industrial) and all 11 services, plus a symptom table that matches six problems people actually notice (breakers that keep tripping, a warm or buzzing panel, dimming lights, a dead or scorched outlet, a new EV or heat pump load, original wiring) to what each usually means and which service fixes it. It also says plainly what to do first if there is a burning smell, explains that permit rules differ between the City of Hagerstown and Washington County, names the owner (Andrew Porter) and the Leitersburg Pike office, and has two ways to send a job request.
